decisions.rationale: Vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor deficiency syndrome does not match the clinical presentation of progressive skin laxity and elastic fiber calcification

option_relations.rationale: Vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor deficiency syndrome does not match the clinical presentation of progressive skin laxity and elastic fiber calcification
Classic pseudoxanthoma elasticum is a subtype of pseudoxanthoma elasticum, which is related to GGCX-related pseudoxanthoma elasticum
Classical Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum (PXE) is another term for classic pseudoxanthoma elasticum, which is related to GGCX-related pseudoxanthoma elasticum
Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with coagulation deficiency matches the clinical presentation and genetic findings of GGCX-related pseudoxanthoma elasticum
